results.title: InvestorNewsBreaks – Wearable Devices Ltd. (NASDAQ: WLDS) Announces Strategic Collaboration With Encord to Advance Physical AI Training Data
results.description: Wearable Devices (NASDAQ: WLDS) announced a strategic collaboration agreement with Cord Technologies Inc. (“Encord”) to combine its wrist-based neural sensing technology with Encord’s Physical AI data infrastructure and visual data capabilities. Led by Kavana, the company’s Physical AI business unit, the collaboration aims to develop multimodal training datasets that integrate neuromuscular signals associated with hand and finger movements with visual information. results.title: Miller says government moving quickly but no timeline for new digital regulator
results.description: Culture Minister Marc Miller says while he shares concerns about how long the government’s new digital regulator will take to set up, he’s unable to say exactly when that will happen.
